opening.argument: The price targets come with a clear limit on the trading thesis. The speaker identifies a weekly close below $1.70 as the point at which he would exit short-term positions, and expressly says he would take the loss. The higher targets are prospective, with the $23 holding conditional on an altseason scenario. The Telegram invitation offers updates through a group described as free; the staking page shows rewards and an account-connection control. Neither establishes a payment request, credential collection, deceptive claim, or transaction outcome tied to the video. This is market analysis that acknowledges risk, not a promise of returns.

citations.quote: My hard invalidation is a weekly close below $1.70. If we lose that level, I'm out of my short-term positions.
I'll take the loss and preserve capital.
Target 1 $3.60 Target 2 $5.60 This is the 618 Fib retracement. Target 3 $11 And if we get a full altseason mania? I keep a moonbag for $23.
If you want to see exactly when I pull the trigger on my next buy, or if I get stopped out, I post those updates in real time, in my free telegram group.
